name: Srivasavi Adhesive Tapes Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2002, Srivasavi Adhesive Tapes Ltd manufactures Adhesive Tapes[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is an ISO 9001:2015 certified company by TUV Nord and engaged in manufacturing/coating, converting and Die cuts of industrial Specialty self-adhesive tapes. It does customized die cutting of Films, Foams and allied products catering to various industries

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 40.7% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
